title: Directions EMEA 2026, Day 1: Copilot Moves from Answers to Actions
summary: Edit with Copilot moves Business Central Copilot from answering questions to performing actual business work like creating, updating, and deleting records through natural language, with early-access preview starting October 2026 and broader public preview in April 2027.
key_points: Edit with Copilot enables users to modify business data using natural language, not just retrieve information
Demonstrated capabilities include creating records, updating fields, deleting records, executing actions, and multistep tasks across pages
Copilot can interact with custom AL extensions including pages, fields, and actions without separate AI integration
Early-access requires Business Central 30.0.56564.0+, partner sandbox, US/UK/Germany, English only; public preview April 2027
Business Skills guide AI processes through natural-language instructions while AL enforces mandatory business rules

quotes.text: Microsoft is moving from Copilot answering questions to Copilot performing actual work in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals a fundamental shift from Copilot as information tool to Copilot as action executor

quotes.text: AI can decide which steps to take. Business Central must still determine which operations are allowed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the architectural principle that AI handles procedures while AL enforces rules and permissions
